police.speaker: Detective Morris
police.text: Morris identifies a radio channel used by the quarry security team.

signal.speaker: David
signal.text: David removes noise from a copy of the recording. Amara identifies the train crossing bell beneath Ethan's signal.

alone.speaker: David
alone.text: David hears the same four beats through the factory wall. Something answers from below.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: Amara finds an old voice memo from the night Ethan vanished. Behind Victor's threat, a second voice counts four slow beats.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: Ethan used those beats to signal when he was hiding during their games. He may have been close enough to leave the clue himself.

dialogues.speaker: Victor
dialogues.text: The recovered file ends with Victor saying, "You taught him that signal."

choices.label: Send the recording to Morris for analysis
choices.impact: Morris can analyze the recording safely, but the signal may be too faint to recover.
choices.response: Morris: I will send the audio to the lab and keep a copy out of the station system.
choices.speaker: Detective Morris

choices.label: Decode the next lead with Amara
choices.impact: David checks the technical evidence. Amara connects it to the people and history behind the records, without police assistance.
choices.response: David preserves the original record and tests the next connection while Amara checks its meaning against what she remembers.
choices.speaker: David

choices.label: Return to the factory and listen on site
choices.impact: The factory may reveal the source, but returning could lead Victor straight to David.
choices.response: David: I will go back to the factory and check the wall while Amara stays on the call.
choices.speaker: David

metadata.episode: A continuing rescue mystery; the final clue opens the next episode.
